note: Hand-selected diseases spanning the hard cases for the matching pipeline. trueTrialCount and truePublicationRange are reference figures checked against the live databases (ClinicalTrials.gov condition search + Europe PMC) on verifiedOn; they are order-of-magnitude ground truth for regression detection, not exact adjudicated tallies. Re-verify periodically and bump verifiedOn. knownDifficulty drives the per-class breakdown in `npm run validate`.
source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 (condition field) and Europe PMC search, manual review.
